description: This file is a TypeScript script for generating a cron usage report by parsing JSONL log files, with functions for argument parsing, file listing, log line parsing, and report formatting.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a key-value object.

methods.name: usageAndExit
methods.description: Displays usage information and exits the process.

methods.name: listJsonlFiles
methods.description: Lists all JSONL files in a directory.

methods.name: safeParseLine
methods.description: Safely parses a log line into a CronRunLogEntry object.

methods.name: fmtInt
methods.description: Formats a number as a localized string with no decimal places.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates argument parsing, file processing, and report generation.
